summary: Configured and verified daily cleanup on node1. Files in /var/tmp/inventory are removed once their modification age reaches seven days. The configuration persisted across the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Created inventory-cleanup.service with a filesystem-bounded regular-file cleanup command.
Created and enabled inventory-cleanup.timer with OnCalendar=daily and Persistent=true.
Ran the cleanup successfully: expired.tmp was removed and current.tmp retained.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the timer, cleanup service, configuration, and retained data after restart.

evidence.requirement: Remove inventory temporary files after seven days while retaining current files
evidence.summary: Captured the old and current timestamps, executed cleanup successfully, then proved expired.tmp was absent and current.tmp remained.
Proved the timer is enabled and active, scheduled for the next midnight, and configured with OnCalendar=daily and Persistent=true.

Captured healthy pre-restart state and boot ID e5bd5a63-fd5e-4e53-8a4a-6c0c574dcb9d, acknowledged the safe reboot, proved the new boot ID 76b3d44d-3929-45cd-83fb-f9f46af67e21, and confirmed post-restart cleanup success, active timer, configuration, and unchanged retained-file checksum.
